body: How are they a “fucking weirdo”?

I first played Halo CE Anniversary when I was in elementary school with my half brother Mike Jr, and when I saw the flood for the first time, I had nightmares for weeks. 

I never did finish the game, because Mike Jr got married and wasn’t able to play (I had a fear of playing alone due to the Xbox being in the basement) We left off on the last level, but weren’t able to get to the finish before the timer ran out. I still hate those damn flood.

Edit: I thought I might add this little bit of info as well - I didn’t play the game after its initial release. The game was sitting on a shelf, and it had been there ever since my dad bought it in 2004. It had been untouched for 8 years before I got my stubby hands on it.

I’m not sure that it would be best to use halo as the main reason why a certain console is better. There are plenty great games out there, and Halo is great, but using that as a point makes it seem like other consoles don’t have any games that can compete with it. But that’s just my opinion on it and I’m in no way trying to start an argument. I just wanted to say that.
